headline: Sky Alloys and Power Limited files Draft Red Herring Prospectus on NSE and BSE
sum: Sky Alloys and Power Limited has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) on the main board platforms of NSE and BSE, marking the formal commencement of its public offering process under SEBI oversight.
detail: Sky Alloys and Power Limited, an industrial company, has filed its DRHP with both major stock exchanges following the standard IPO submission protocol. The filing was intimated by Gretex Corporate Services Limited, suggesting its role as a merchant banker or corporate advisor. The company has now entered the formal SEBI pre-listing review phase, during which market regulator observations on financial disclosures, business risk factors, and governance structures must be addressed prior to RHP and final prospectus publication.
